transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I teach high school, and... well, I'll sit down with a stack of essays or some curriculum documents, fully intending to get it done. But... I don't know, maybe ten minutes later, I'll realize I've just been staring at the exact same page. 

I end up thinking about three completely different things, and I'm barely taking in what's right in front of me. So... yeah. That's why I made the appointment.
Looking back, were you having this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose I did. Um. Even back in primary school, my report cards usually said things like... "bright but careless." Or that I wouldn't finish my work unless I was closely supervised. And... my parents were always pulling crumpled worksheets out of my backpack that I'd just... forgotten to turn in. So, yeah.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No. Um... I don't think so. Just... frustrated with the work stuff, I guess. But not depressed.
Do you often find yourself unable to focus because your mind is occupied by worry?
No, not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I'm worried about much. Just... normal stuff, I guess. It's not worry that distracts me. My mind just sort of... wanders off.
